title: Remove All Adjacent Duplicates In String
goal: Repeatedly remove adjacent equal character pairs until none remain.
strategy: The stack is the reduced prefix. A matching incoming character removes its top; otherwise it extends the reduced prefix.

phasePurposes.inspect: The stack is the reduced prefix. A matching incoming character removes its top; otherwise it extends the reduced prefix.
phasePurposes.update: The stack contains no adjacent equal pair; removing one pair may expose another.
phasePurposes.done: The stack contains no adjacent equal pair; removing one pair may expose another.

inputRules: Inputs are validated against this algorithm’s domain and the documented visualization size limits.
